policy: Three final accepted source states remove four once-loops and three explicit interworking-thunk calls. Complete patches apply independently to base_commit. A shared-header candidate includes the necessary header addition in its patch and records every file hash. Historical scores concern the named function only and are not semantic proof; independent full-unit stock extents are recorded for accepted states.

label: direct

label: indexed-slots
hypotheses: Index the actual 24 shared controller slots and their state members, eliminating parallel raw state and slot cursors.

label: indexed-callbacks
hypotheses: Invoke the real state callbacks with their two typed pool/slot arguments during indexed traversal, as the neighboring bouncing-object pool does.

label: typed-slot-cursor
hypotheses: Traverse actual shared slot objects with one cursor and read state through the object, following the neighboring destroy/allocate routines.

label: indexed-existing-base
hypotheses: Index the original precomputed slot-array base, retaining its existing lifetime and loop setup while removing the parallel raw field cursor. This is actual immutable-base array traversal, not a new pointer-copy replacement.

label: indexed-native-callback
hypotheses: Check whether ordinary typed callback invocation also removes the surviving explicit interworking-thunk call from the now-matching indexed sprite-controller traversal.
